title: Test runner invoked wrongly (MODULE_NOT_FOUND before any test ran) is a test-defect
context: Field trial 3, AgentDesk. EXEC-2026-00001: node --test was given a directory and died with MODULE_NOT_FOUND before running any test.
observed_failure: No signal token described a harness-invocation error. The agent tried module-not-found and test-defect; both silently returned unclassified, with no warning that the tokens were unknown.
reasoning_notes: A harness that never reached a test says nothing about the product. Unknown signal tokens now come back as unknown_signals with a hint instead of being dropped silently.
